name: calculator
description: Evaluate arithmetic. Input either {"a": number, "b": number, "op": "+|-|*|/|^"} or {"expr": "2+3*4"} (operators + - * / ^, parentheses, standard precedence). Returns {"ok": true, "result": number}.

expr.description: Arithmetic expression such as "2+3*4" or "(1+2)^3". Operators + - * / ^, parentheses, standard precedence. When present, a/b/op are ignored.
